newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains end firmer, helped by easier stg.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains end firmer, helped by easier stg.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended firmer, helped by an easier sterling, traders said.
But activity was limited with just 153 lots done in all, 85 of them on active November.
It last traded 0.85 stg higher at 84.00 stg.
All the contracts which traded on barley rose by 1.00 stg, with active November last traded at 79.75 stg. November volume was 15 of a total 30 on barley.
Optimism ahead of the EU's first tender of the new 1997-98 marketing year helped the market higher, one trader said. But he was unimpressed by the 105,000 tonnes of wheat granted.
Physical market traders said activity was low, with sellers holding back at current prices.
